pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:206 The desktop settings store fans out into seven separate IPC read commands at startup instead of batching, performs optimistic UI mutations without rollback on write failure, and lacks store-side key validation, setting kind classification, or audit recording.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:107 Write path delegates to generic key-value store without a store-side allowlist, orphan detection, or retirement reaping.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:220 Typed read boundary parses and validates stored string values via type guard, falling back to declared default without persisting it.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:206 Startup fans out into seven separate single-key store_get IPC calls across the boundary instead of executing a bulk read or batched query.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:70 Settings are aggregated as a flat interface without declaring kinds (preference, operational config, ceiling, flag) or per-kind contracts.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:52 Resolves theme against the live OS source continuously via media query listeners, storing the system choice rather than the resolved value.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:117 Setting mutations write directly to the store without producing audit records of old/new values, timestamps, categories, or origins.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:114 State and UI attributes are updated optimistically before write, with no rollback or error recovery to restore truth if settingWrite fails.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:207 Settings resolve from a single SQLite store rather than a declared multi-source precedence chain across CLI, env, and files.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:208 The store is read-write with singular key access, without read-only multi-name grace period fallbacks.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:96 Defaults are scalar values rather than user-editable collections of shipped items requiring an applied-defaults ledger.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:226 Corrupted or unreadable local store state silently falls back to hardcoded defaults without bounded backup rotation or a boot-time restore prompt.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.ts:2 Configuration is held in database rows rather than author-authored hierarchical include graphs.
apps/desktop/src/stores/settings.test.ts:131 Store granularity is individual key rows rather than a single structural document.

pairs.registryProposal: In settings.md, author-declared-include-graph is listed in the frontmatter techniques array and exists as a technique file, but is omitted from the markdown summary list under ## The techniques.

declined.subject: settings
declined.reason: The context consists of UI presentation scene components for the Voice studio/settings and Waking arrival screens; it does not implement, own, or manage an application settings store (ADR 0085/0087; waking/reopen.ts:4 notes the UI avoids touching store rows, and API keys are delegated to the credential vault).
